items.title: Nuclear foundations and fusion reaction physics
items.rationale: The graph starts before plasma physics so a reader with no nuclear-physics background can enter safely.

items.title: Confinement criteria, plasma fundamentals, and magnetic confinement
items.rationale: Covers the common plasma foundation before device-specific depth.

items.title: Inertial confinement and experimental measurement
items.rationale: Keeps inertial confinement in the core curriculum and explicitly trains metric/measurement literacy.

items.title: Heating, equilibrium, stability, transport, and exhaust
items.rationale: Maps the central plasma-dynamics problems that control achievable confinement.

items.title: Fusion-plant technology: magnets, fuel cycle, neutrons, materials, blankets, and safety
items.rationale: Prevents the course from equating successful plasma physics with a complete energy system.

items.title: Power balance, systems engineering, economics, and deployment
items.rationale: Tracks whole-plant performance and coupled engineering decisions separately from fusion gain.

items.title: Computational and concept-comparison methods
items.rationale: Provides a route from physical models to reproducible calculations and fair comparison.

items.title: Research literacy and evolving fusion frontier
items.rationale: Higher levels require primary/authoritative evidence checks and explicit refresh dates because the field changes quickly.
